Apex Neural Rendering，一个通过 OptiScaler 注入: Apex Neural Rendering is a frame-generation / upscaling DLL injected into games through OptiScaler. Turn on frame generation in-game to raise FPS without changing your GPU.
本工具会读 Steam 的 libraryfolders.vdf、Epic 清单: This tool reads Steam's libraryfolders.vdf, Epic manifests and the GOG registry to find installed games; you can add a folder manually if scanning misses it.
